newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish group says June pulp stocks likely down.
newsitem.headline: Swedish group says June pulp stocks likely down.

text.p: Consultancy group Momentum said on Wednesday some pulp stockpiles in Sweden and Finland fell by 10,000 tonnes in June, which pointed to a decrease in North American and Scandinavian (Norscan) pulp inventories.
"Preliminary figures show producer stocks of pulp in Sweden and Finland fell by about 10,000 tonnes in June," Momentum said in a statement.
"This can be an indication that the so-called NorScan stocks continued to fall, for the fourth month running," it said.
